body.x: Leverpresso will participate in the world’s largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 to showcase the world’s first lever-type espresso extractor.
The company official said, "We created the world's first portable lever-type espresso extractor in the espresso maker market, which had only a large lever machine."
The lever-type portable espresso made by Leverpresso makes hot espresso with just water and coffee bean, without electricity or other types of fuel.

By using two levers, users can extract good espresso with precision and minimal channel work with nine levels of pressure. In addition, with the light weight of 450g, anyone can enjoy a cup of coffee quickly and easily anytime and anywhere.

The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January. AVING NEWS has reported the most news on CES, MWC, and IFA, the world's three major tech exhibitions for the past 13 years. It is sending special reporters to CES this year to report major issues in the global market and introduce outstanding Korean companies to the world.
